The date and the sky

attestedThe text says: “twelve nights gone of Rabīʿ al-Awwal, on a Monday, when the forenoon heat grew strong and the sun had nearly reached its height” (لاثنتي عشرة ليلة خلت من شهر ربيع الأول يوم الاثنين، حين اشتد الضحاء، وكادت الشمس تعتدل), vol. 1, p. 492. English is an AI draft.

Case: Which Monday?

attestedThe arrival at Quba is dated the 12th of Rabīʿ al-awwal, a Monday. (section 696, vol. 1, p. 491)

attestedThe Prophet's arrival at Madinah is dated to twelve nights gone of Rabīʿ al-Awwal. (section 864, vol. 1, p. 590)

  • computedbefore lunation: Thursday 26 August 622
  • computedtabular lunation: Friday 24 September 622
  • computedafter lunation: Sunday 24 October 622

The weekday in the text and the computed weekday are kept apart. A mismatch is a question for the scholars, never a correction.
